question: Identify the option that is NOT an actual season in India according to meteorologists.
solution:
The correct answer is** "the westerlies season".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Westerlies** are the permanent winds that blow in the middle latitudes.
 
• The winds flow from** subtropical high-pressure belts** to lower-pressure belts.
 
• The westerlies of the **southern hemisphere** **are more constant and high**, with so-called **'Brave west winds'** striking chile, Tasmania, and New Zealand.
 
• The westerlies vary their strength with the polar cyclone.** Cyclone **reaches maximum intensity during winters and the strength of **westerlies increases.**
 
• During **summers** cyclone reaches a minimum so that** westerlies decreases.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The retreating monsoon season** begins with the withdrawal of the South-west monsoon around September to November and ends in early January. The South-west monsoon winds become weak and start from North India. During this season tropic cyclones emerge from the Bay of Bengal. This season brings rainfall to different areas in different amounts.
 
• **The cold weather season** begins in November and remains till February in North India. December and January are the coldest months. As the temperature lowers fog and mists are noticed. Heavy rainfall and snowfall are seen in this season.
 
• **The southwest monsoon season **begins in June and ends in September. Southwest monsoon is caused by an intense low-pressure system that is formed over the Tibetan plateau.
